title: I Walk the Line
syncedLyrics:
[00:21.77]I keep a close watch on this heart of mine
[00:26.21]I keep my eyes wide open all the time
[00:30.68]I keep the ends out for the tie that binds
[00:35.35]Because you're mine, I walk the line
[00:48.91]I find it very, very easy to be true
[00:53.23]I find myself alone when each day is through
[00:57.81]Yes, I'll admit that I'm a fool for you
[01:02.27]Because you're mine, I walk the line
[01:15.89]As sure as night is dark and day is light
[01:20.39]I keep you on my mind both day and night
[01:24.79]And happiness I've known proves that it's right
[01:29.22]Because you're mine, I walk the line
[01:43.54]You've got a way to keep me on your side
[01:48.48]You give me cause for love that I can't hide
[01:53.05]For you I know I'd even try to turn the tide
[01:57.34]Because you're mine, I walk the line
[02:11.40]I keep a close watch on this heart of mine
[02:16.49]I keep my eyes wide open all the time
[02:20.72]I keep the ends out for the tie that binds
